deferred_verification.description: RAW-verify proxy timeout resolution unchanged after rebuild — the 5x proxy-timeout fallback multiplier moved from an inline `overrideMs==0 { *5 }` literal in proxy.go's serveProxied into a named domain.DefaultProxyTimeoutMultiplier constant + domain.ServiceConfig.EffectiveProxyTimeoutMs() accessor, called from the two serveProxied call sites in proxy.go (mcp not-deployed reroute path, generic service path). Resolved timeout values are unchanged by construction (unit-pinned) but this is the hottest-path prod HTTP handler so live behavior gets independent confirmation post-rebuild.
deferred_verification.check: After rebuilding api-gateway container: (1) hit a deployed service with no ProxyTimeoutMs override (e.g. /stock/health) and confirm normal proxy pass-through with no premature timeout (health-probe TimeoutMs=2000ms -> effective proxy budget 10000ms unchanged from pre-refactor); (2) hit a service with explicit ProxyTimeoutMs override (macro or news, 120000ms) with a slow/long-running upstream call and confirm it is NOT cut off before 120s and still respects the 120s ceiling; (3) hit the not-deployed mcp-reroute path (e.g. /kinh-dich/...) and confirm it still resolves via mcpSvc.EffectiveProxyTimeoutMs() (10000ms default, since mcp has no override) with unchanged reroute behavior.
deferred_verification.acceptance: curl :4000/stock/... proxies through successfully within old ~10s budget same as pre-refactor; curl :4000/macro/... or /news/... long-running scrape completes without truncation inside 120s same as pre-refactor; curl :4000/kinh-dich/... reroute-to-mcp path unchanged (503/200 per existing mapping, no new timeout errors).

notes: Per DoD: rebuild_required=true (hottest live-serving HTTP path). Named the 5x multiplier as domain.DefaultProxyTimeoutMultiplier (pkg/domain/models.go) with a new domain.ServiceConfig.EffectiveProxyTimeoutMs() accessor method — placed in pkg/domain (not pkg/infrastructure/registry.go as the original backlog note suggested) because pkg/interface/http/proxy.go is barred by the Fence-C depguard rule from importing pkg/infrastructure directly (only cmd/server/main.go may); domain is the layer both proxy.go and registry.go can reach. proxy.go's serveProxied signature simplified from (overrideMs, timeoutMs int64) to a single pre-resolved effectiveMs int64 — both call sites (mcp reroute path, generic service path) now call svc.EffectiveProxyTimeoutMs()/mcpSvc.EffectiveProxyTimeoutMs() instead of inlining the *5 fallback.
